title: UPI Stays Free. The Legislation Behind It Changes Everything.
summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman made a surprising announcement in the Rajya Sabha that few noticed but everyone should have: UPI will never be free for consumers. The Taxation Laws (Amendment) Act, 2025, has now given the central government the legal authority to charge MDR on UPI transactions. This is not happening today, but the legal framework has shifted in a way that makes it possible tomorrow. For Indian fintech startups, the question is not whether — but how to prepare.
